Failed deliveries, one thread per task (prod first) holding its asks and notes, notes
without a task, then held answers, most urgent first. enter opens the row under the cursor
(a thread opens its timeline), z or →← folds a thread, a answers a session's asks, f replies
to a note, m marks a note read or unread (a thread: all its notes read), M marks them all
read, T moves a note to another task, r retries a failed delivery, c writes to chief (about
the thread under the cursor).
↑↓ · enter open · a answer · c chief · ? help · q quit · ^u/^d J/K scroll · g/G top/bottom
